answer: The specified analysis could not be completed in this environment: gseapy (with the Reactome_2022 gene-set library) and any DESeq2 backend (R/DESeq2, pyDESeq2) are unavailable and unobtainable (no network access; no offline gene-set library anywhere in the filesystem). Therefore the required gseapy.enrichr(gene_sets='Reactome_2022') over-representation analysis on the differentially expressed genes (p<0.05, |lfc|>0.5, baseMean>10) for the CBD/cisplatin combination treatment (group 9 Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50 vs group 3 DMSO vehicle) could not be executed, and the "primary cellular mechanism enriched in the CBD/cisplatin combination treatment" can NOT be determined via the specified pipeline. This is a limitation conclusion, not an inferred mechanism; no enrichment result is reported. What WAS executed is the DEG stage with a DESeq2-equivalent NB-GLM (approved design=~Group; contrast group9 vs group3; baseMean>10 & |log2FC|>0.5 & BH padj<0.05): 1,791 DEGs (985 up / 806 down), then ENSG->symbol mapping (unmapped dropped, duplicate symbols kept by max baseMean) giving 1,693 gene symbols. Evidence retained in analysis_de.py (executed), res_all_genes_g9_vs_DMSO.csv, deg_g9_vs_DMSO.csv, and LIMITATIONS.md.
